utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, I saw a flyer near the entrance — repairs on our block should be around 2 PM tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That's right, Dane! We'll start gathering at 2 PM sharp. You should drop off any spare tools or materials.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it, I'll bring my toolbox and see if I can scrounge up some extra screws or brackets before then.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Tess, have you seen if that repair truck finally moved from Johnson's to the corner lot? I've been tracking it all weekend.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, honey, I haven't checked today, but I know Cleo's been running that repair drive from the old garage, not a truck. You sure it wasn't the pickup they were borrowing for transport?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I'm sure it's a proper repair truck, Tess. I saw it myself parked stubbornly by Johnson's yesterday afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, so you're saying it's definitely happening? I still haven't seen any flyers or announcements.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh, it's definitely happening! I've already got my schedule set—Saturday, 9 AM at the community center. Mrs. Chen even asked me to help move her old furniture to the repair tent.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: But I still haven't seen any official notice from Rosa or the neighborhood council. Are you sure you didn't just decide this yourself?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Did you hear from Opal about that truck? She seemed pretty set on checking the corner lot herself.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, I heard about that. I'm actually gearing up to help Vik with hauling stuff from Mrs. Chen's for the repair drive—got my truck ready.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, so Vik's getting involved with furniture too? I thought the drive was just for bikes and appliances, but I guess things are getting bigger.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, Pia! You're coming to the repair drive this Saturday, right? I think I finally remembered—it's at the old garage from 9 to 3.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Wait, Saturday? I thought we were looking at tomorrow afternoon—has the schedule changed without me noticing?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh no, did I get it wrong again? Cleo told me Saturday, but maybe I mixed up the dates.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh, that's strange. I heard from Tess it's Saturday 9 to 3, but Mina just told me 10 to 4. I'm getting mixed signals, so I'll probably just show up early.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can double-check the board on my morning walk and let you know what I find.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Uli, that would be a huge help! I'll aim to be there by 9, but I'll keep an eye out for your message.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Just got word that repair truck moved to the corner lot—finally, we can get that drive cleared up this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great news, Gus! I'll round up some folks from the block and we can make quick work of it Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Perfect, I'll bring my toolbox and some spare parts—see you at the lot Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, Jules! I'm so glad you're here. I need to let you know the repair drive has been moved to Sunday at the community center instead of Saturday on my porch.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, thanks for the heads-up! I'll make sure to update the flyers and let everyone know about the change.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That's great, Jules. And if you need help printing the flyers, just let me know—I can take care of that.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Leo, thanks again for offering to pick up the Johnson's old fridge this afternoon. I'll let them know to expect you.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: No problem. I'll head over after lunch.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, I'll give the Johnsons a quick heads-up so they're ready for you.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey, so it's Saturday morning at the community center with tool donations. Got it, thanks. I'll dig up that old drill.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, I think that's the plan. I still haven't seen an official flyer, but I'll bring my hammer if I can find it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Alright, cool. Well, I gotta run, but I'll see you there with the drill then.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Are you planning to bring something to fix, or just help out?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I'll be helping organize, but I might bring an old lamp that needs rewiring.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Gotcha. What kind of lamp is it—anything tricky with the wiring, or just a standard fix?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: So, Noah, I've been meaning to double-check—is the repair drive still set for Saturday from 10 to 4? I want to bring my wobbly chair.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Uh, Saturday? I think so... but I'm not sure about the time. Is it 10 to 4? I better check my notes again.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: No problem, Noah. Let's double-check with Cleo to confirm the time.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, I remember seeing a notice tacked to the bulletin board by the mailboxes. It said they'd be on our street around 2 PM tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Huh, I walk past that board every day and didn't see anything. Are you sure it wasn't for something else?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I'm pretty sure it said 'repair drive' in bold at the top, maybe it was tucked under another flyer?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Ira! Have you heard about the neighborhood repair drive this Saturday? We're fixing up old bikes and tools together—come join us!

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh hey Quinn, yeah I've been hearing bits about it—I even offered to haul some stuff with my truck. Saturday sounds good, what time does it start?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great to have you on board! We're kicking off at 9 AM at the community center—bring your truck and we'll put it to good use!

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh hey, Mina! I was just thinking about that repair drive—wait, do you know when it's supposed to be again?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: It's Saturday from 10am to 4pm. Are you planning to bring something to fix?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Saturday, right—I knew that. I think I was going to bring my old blender, but now I'm not sure if I even have it anymore.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Cleo, do we have a clear schedule for the repair drive? I'm worried about overlapping with the block party.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, no worries there, Pia—the repair drive is Saturday morning, and the block party's in the afternoon, so they won't overlap at all.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, that's a relief—thanks for clarifying! So we have the morning for the drive and the afternoon free for the block party.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, Leo! I keep forgetting—do you know when that repair drive is? I think I wrote it down but I can't find my notes.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Saturday, 9 AM. I've got my tools ready.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Saturday! Right, that's what I thought. I should probably just tape a note to my front door so I don't forget again.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Say, Rosa, I just got a chance to check my toolshed—I've got a couple extra hammers and a wrench set I'm happy to bring to the repair drive on Saturday. Want me to swing by your place beforehand to grab anything?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, Gus, that's wonderful—thank you! But I should mention, the drive got moved to Sunday at the community center instead. Could you still bring those tools there?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sunday at the community center, got it. I'll bring the tools there—no problem at all.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Quinn, thanks for organizing this—I've got some spare time Saturday to help with those fence posts.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, Rey! I've been helping with the schedule—let me know if you need any supplies for those fence posts.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Sam. I think I have what I need, but I'll let you know if not. So the repair drive is Saturday, right?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Mara, I'm heading to the coffee shop tomorrow to hand out flyers for the repair drive — want to grab a cup and help me spread the word?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That sounds like a great idea, Jules! I'll meet you there at 10 with some extra flyers.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect, see you then! I'll grab us some coffee while we work.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Hana, quick question—that repair drive Saturday at 10 at the community center, right? I think I've got an old drill to drop off.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, that's right! Saturday from 10 to 4 at the community center. A drill would be great—I know Cleo mentioned they're collecting tools for fixing fences and faucets.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it, Saturday 10 to 4. I'll bring the drill. Thanks, Hana!

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Saturday at 9 works for me. I'll have my shed open an hour early for anyone who wants to help sort.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that's great, Eli! I'll spread the word about the early sorting—maybe we can get a good crew together before the main event.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Perfect, Nell. I'll have the coffee on too—come by whenever you're ready.
